title: Note lengths as fractions of a whole note
examples: How many beats is a minim?
How many quavers make a crotchet?

explain.say: Imagine a pizza. You can eat it whole, or cut it into halves, quarters or eighths. Music notes work just like that! Look at the board: four notes, each lasting a different number of beats. The biggest is the semibreve, the whole note: 4 beats.

draw.text: Note lengths as fractions of a whole note

explain.say: Look at the minim, the half note. It lasts half as long as the semibreve: 2 beats. Say ta-a and hold it for two taps. How many minims fit in one semibreve?

Now the crotchet, the quarter note: just 1 beat, like one step when you walk. Look at the bar on the board: one crotchet is one quarter of the whole. Below it, see two quavers? Each quaver is an eighth, half a beat, so two of them fill the same space as one crotchet. Can you see they match?

Here is a puzzle. Two crotchets are two quarters. Look at the top bar: two quarters. Now the bottom bar: one half. They are exactly the same length! So two crotchets last as long as one minim. How many crotchets fit in a semibreve?

Four! Super counting. In America and many other places, these are simply called whole, half, quarter and eighth notes. Wow fact: a semibreve lasts as long as eight quavers! Challenge: clap a bar with one minim and two crotchets: ta-a, ta, ta.

faq.a: A semibreve, called a whole note in American English, usually lasts 4 beats. It is drawn as an open oval with no stem.
A minim, or half note, usually lasts 2 beats, half as long as a semibreve. It is an open oval with a stem.
asks: How many beats is a minim?

faq.a: A crotchet, or quarter note, usually lasts 1 beat. It is a filled-in oval with a stem, and it is the most common beat note.
A quaver, or eighth note, lasts half a beat. It has a filled oval, a stem and a little tail, and two quavers last as long as one crotchet.
asks: How many quavers make a crotchet?

faq.q: Why are notes named like fractions?
faq.a: In the American system each note is a fraction of the whole note: half, quarter, eighth. Each one lasts half as long as the one before.
asks: Why is it called a quarter note?

facts: In 4/4 time a semibreve lasts 4 beats, a minim 2, a crotchet 1 and a quaver half a beat.
British English uses semibreve, minim, crotchet and quaver; American English uses whole, half, quarter and eighth note.

quiz.say: How many crotchets last as long as one minim?
quiz.why: A minim is 2 beats and a crotchet is 1 beat, so two crotchets fill a minim.

wrong.1: Four crotchets fill a semibreve, not a minim.
wrong.2: One crotchet is only half a minim.

quiz.say: How many beats does a quaver last?
quiz.why: A quaver is an eighth note, half the length of a crotchet.
